method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: Account decisions can be appealed by e-mail to the compliance team, which reviews the case.
Prohibited practices are listed (gap trading, HFT, latency arbitrage, one-sided betting, hedging...); no clause giving the firm discretion to refuse earned payouts was found in the archived terms.
